title: {{token}} hover preview in the URL bar never fires — transparent input intercepts pointer events
description: Hovering a {{var}} chip in the URL bar is supposed to show a resolved-value preview line under the URL bar (docs/features/environments.md: 'Per-token hover preview under URL bar'). It never appears. The url-input is rendered `absolute inset-0 z-[var(--z-raised)]` directly on top of the syntax-highlight overlay that renders the hoverable `env-token` spans. Even though those spans have `pointer-events-auto`, a fully-covering sibling above them in the stacking order (the input, which is not `pointer-events-none`) intercepts all pointer events for the whole box, so `mouseenter` never reaches the span. Confirmed with `document.elementFromPoint()` at the token's screen center in a live dev-server session: it resolves to `INPUT[data-testid=url-input]`, not the `env-token` span. Regressed by commit 9af2269 ('Enhance tab functionality and add SSE support'), which restructured the URL bar for long-URL scroll-sync and put the input above the overlay instead of below it (previously the overlay held `z-[var(--z-raised)]` and the input did not).
testStep: 1. Open the app (pnpm dev or pnpm tauri dev). 2. Create an environment with a `host` variable and set it active. 3. In the URL bar, type `https://{{host}}/ping`. 4. Hover the `{{host}}` chip. Expected: a preview line appears under the URL bar showing `{{host}} → <resolved value>`. Actual: nothing appears; no hover state is ever entered on the token span. Automated repro: `apps/desktop/e2e/environments.spec.ts` test 'hovering a {{token}} in the URL shows its resolved value' (line 64) times out on `.hover()` and fails deterministically (verified 4/4 runs, including an isolated `--repeat-each=3`).
